pairs: Verbum Domini, quod factum est ad Osee,
The word of the Lord that came to Hosea,
in the days of Uzziah, Jotham,
and in the days of Jeroboam,
The beginning of the Lord’s conversation with Hosea.
Et dixit Dominus ad Osee: Vade,
And the Lord said to Hosea: “Go,
take to yourself a wife of fornications,
and make for yourself sons of fornications, because,
quia fornicans fornicabitur terra a Domino.
by fornicating, the land will fornicate away from the Lord.”
Et abiit, et accepit Gomer, filiam Debelaim:
And he went out and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim;
et concepit, et peperit ei filium.
and she conceived and bore him a son.
And the Lord said to him:
et visitabo sanguinem Jezrahel super domum Jehu,
I will visit the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu,
et quiescere faciam regnum domus Israël.
and I will put the kingdom of the house of Israel to rest.
Et in illa die conteram arcum Israël in valle Jezrahel.
And in that day, I will crush the stronghold of Israel in the valley of Jezreel.”
she conceived and bore a daughter.
quia non addam ultra misereri domui Israël,
for I will no longer have mercy on the house of Israel,
but I will utterly forget them.
Et domui Juda miserebor, et salvabo eos in Domino Deo suo;
Yet I will have mercy on the house of Judah,
et non salvabo eos in arcu et gladio,
and I will save them by the Lord their God.
et in bello, et in equis, et in equitibus.
And I will not save them by bow and sword and battle and horses and horsemen.”
Et ablactavit eam quæ erat Absque misericordia.
And she conceived and bore a son.
for you are not my people,
and I will not be yours.
Et erit numerus filiorum Israël quasi arena maris,
And the number of the sons of Israel will be like the sand of the sea,
which is without measure and cannot be numbered.
And in the place where it will be said to them,
Et erit in loco ubi dicetur eis:
it will be said to them,
‘You are the sons of the living God.’
Et congregabuntur filii Juda et filii Israël pariter;
And the sons of Judah, and the sons of Israel, will be gathered together.
And they will place over themselves one head,
and they will rise up from the earth,
for great is the day of Jezreel.”
